{{Top|leg}}
'''Wargame simulation 7-3A''' was a combat simulation used by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The scenario simulating the fighting on the [[Novare Coast]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]], where combatants from each team would attempt to take control of artillery emplacements in order to destroy the enemy's shielded bunker. Lethal firepower was authorized during the scenario.<ref name="Warzone">{{TORcite|type=warzone|Novare Coast}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The wargame simulation serves as the in-universe explanation as to why two Imperial teams would be fighting each other in the Novare Coast Warzone in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is mentioned by the announcer during the 90-second waiting period before the match begins.<ref name="Warzone" />
